children: Cue Biopharma announced positive Phase 2 topline results for CUE-221 in chronic spontaneous urticaria, showing dose‑responsive primary and secondary endpoints and a favorable safety profile.
Phase 2 trial in China (N=145) met primary endpoint HSS7=0 at week 12 across all CUE-221 doses (4/2/1 mg/kg Q4W) vs placebo.
Key secondary UAS7=0 was statistically significant at the 4 mg/kg dose (46% vs 11% placebo; p<0.05).
Complete hive resolution peaked at week 22 and persisted through week 28 off treatment for 4 mg/kg (60%), with post‑hoc delta vs omalizumab 36% (p<0.05).
Favorable safety: no treatment‑related serious adverse events, no hypersensitivity/anaphylaxis; injection site reactions infrequent.
Cue plans to advance CUE-221 to a Phase 2b/3 registration trial in CSU and pursue a Phase 2 in food allergy, subject to FDA review.
